title: TokenPulse Rule Catalog
description: Versioned, operator-tunable catalog holding the spike parameters and the recommendation rules. Any threshold change requires a version bump + CHANGELOG entry + tests (FR-029a).

version.description: e.g. 'v1'. Recorded on every SpikeFlag and Recommendation.

multiple.description: T: flag a day when actual >= T * rolling-7d baseline. Default '2.5' (FR-019).

high_floor_usd.description: Excess (actual - baseline) must be >= this for severity 'high'. Default '50'.

critical_floor_usd.description: Excess must be >= this for severity 'critical'. Default '200'.

severity_ratio_bands.description: Upper bounds as multiples of T. r=actual/baseline. low:[T,2T) moderate:[2T,3T) high:[3T,5T) critical:>=5T (FR-020a).

produces_savings.description: false for flag-only rules; estimated_savings_micros stays null (FR-027).

thresholds.description: Rule-specific tunables. Keys per rule id, all decimal strings.

savings_formula.description: Human-readable formula recorded in Recommendation.savings_basis. Required when produces_savings is true.

assumptions.description: Conservative-estimate assumptions (FR-027). Required when produces_savings is true.

decimal.description: Decimal string; parsed with Decimal, never float.
